title: Recording behind Billie Holiday with Teddy Wilson's studio groups
summary: He and Cozy Cole recorded often with Billie Holiday under Teddy Wilson (Brunswick or Vocalion), with Goodman, Hodges, Carney, Ben Webster and later Lester Young sitting in on dates.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
